description: Two-panel composite figure, both panels being X-ray diffraction (XRD) patterns plotted with 2θ (degree) on the abscissa from 30 to 100 with labelled ticks every 10°, and "Intensity (a.u.)" on the ordinate with no numeric scale. Panel (a), headed "0.02Nb steels", stacks three vertically offset patterns for aging at 723 K/3 h (bottom, black), 723 K/6 h (middle, red) and 723 K/9 h (top, blue); panel (b), headed "0.04Nb steels", repeats the same three 723 K/3 h, 6 h and 9 h patterns for the 0.04Nb steel. Reflections are indexed in both panels as (111)γ and (110)δ, which form the two dominant low-angle peaks just above 40°, followed at higher angles by the much weaker (200)γ, (200)δ, (220)γ, (211)δ, (311)γ and (222)γ lines. No numeric peak positions, intensities or phase fractions are printed. The three diffractograms in each steel are essentially superimposable apart from slight intensity variation, with no new reflection emerging as aging proceeds, so the figure demonstrates that ferrite (δ) and austenite (γ) remain the only phases detectable by XRD in both the 0.02Nb and 0.04Nb steels after 3, 6 and 9 h at 723 K.

observations.observation: Panel (a) contains three vertically offset XRD traces labelled "723 K/3 h" (bottom, black), "723 K/6 h" (middle, red) and "723 K/9 h" (top, blue), under the heading "0.02Nb steels".
Panel (b) repeats the same three aging conditions (723 K/3 h, 723 K/6 h, 723 K/9 h) under the heading "0.04Nb steels".
Both panels share the axes 2θ (degree) from 30 to 100 with ticks at 30, 40, 50, 60, 70, 80, 90 and 100, and "Intensity (a.u.)" with no numeric values printed.
The two strongest reflections in every trace are the adjacent low-angle peaks labelled (111)γ and (110)δ, located just above 40° 2θ.
Further labelled reflections are (200)γ near 50° 2θ and the much weaker (200)δ, (220)γ, (211)δ, (311)γ and (222)γ lines at higher angles, the same index set appearing in panels (a) and (b).
Within each panel the three traces for 3 h, 6 h and 9 h show the same set of reflections with no additional or disappearing peak, indicating no new phase forms with longer aging.
Both panels are diffraction patterns, not micrographs; no scale bar or magnification is present.
The caption states the panels are XRD patterns of the 0.02Nb and 0.04Nb steels aged at 723 K for different periods.
The citing text states the XRD patterns cover 0.02Nb and 0.04Nb steels aged at 723 K for 3, 6 and 9 h.

The citing text asserts that despite the alteration in aging period the primary phases in the Nb-containing steels remain ferrite and austenite, without observable new diffraction peak in the XRD patterns.

subfigures.description: XRD patterns of the 0.02Nb steel, headed "0.02Nb steels", showing three vertically offset traces labelled 723 K/3 h (bottom, black), 723 K/6 h (middle, red) and 723 K/9 h (top, blue) over 2θ = 30-100°. Peaks indexed (111)γ, (110)δ, (200)γ at low angle and weak (200)δ, (220)γ, (211)δ, (311)γ, (222)γ lines at higher angle.

XRD patterns of the 0.04Nb steel, headed "0.04Nb steels", with the same three aging conditions (723 K/3 h black, 6 h red, 9 h blue) and the same indexation; peak positions and relative intensities match panel (a) closely, with no additional reflection after longer aging.
